newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends flat vs dlr, stronger vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends flat vs dlr, stronger vs basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed a quiet afternoon trading on Monday unchanged versus the dollar, remaining strong against the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) currency basket, dealers said.
The forint ended at 192.50 to the dollar, compared with 192.50/55 at midday and 192.45/50 at the opening.
Dealers said the dollar/mark cross, which is usually the main influencing factor on the forint, hardly moved and gave little impetus to the forint.
In the afternoon the forint traded right at the NBH resistance level (bid), its usual place, after almost closing a 30 filler opening gap by midday.

Dealers said economic fundamentals justified the forint's return to the NBH bid, after a few days of slightly volatile trading on uncertainties in the region over the Polish zloty's weakness and some profit-takings on Hungary's stock and government securities markets.
They added that the forint may drift away marginally from the NBH bid again this week but only for short periods as no economic factors were seen weakening the forint substantially.
"A five to 10 filler easing is possible if the dollar/mark will be hectic," said Gyorgy Bukta of BNP-Dresdner Bank.
